product_images_source.name: product_images_source
product_images_source.value: "product_images"."url" IS NOT NULL OR "product_images"."art_key" IS NOT NULL

suppliers_rates_bps.name: suppliers_rates_bps
suppliers_rates_bps.value: coalesce("suppliers"."on_time_rate_bps", 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND coalesce("suppliers"."fill_rate_bps", 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND coalesce("suppliers"."defect_rate_bps", 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 10000

bid_ledger_sign_by_type.name: bid_ledger_sign_by_type
bid_ledger_sign_by_type.value:
("bid_ledger_entries"."type" IN ('BID_PACK_PURCHASE', 'PROMOTIONAL_CREDIT', 'BID_REFUND', 'BUY_NOW_RECOVERY') AND "bid_ledger_entries"."credits" > 0)
        OR ("bid_ledger_entries"."type" IN ('AUCTION_BID', 'EXPIRY') AND "bid_ledger_entries"."credits" < 0)
        OR "bid_ledger_entries"."type" = 'ADMIN_ADJUSTMENT'

bid_ledger_promotional_expiry.name: bid_ledger_promotional_expiry
bid_ledger_promotional_expiry.value: NOT ("bid_ledger_entries"."bucket" = 'PROMOTIONAL' AND "bid_ledger_entries"."credits" > 0) OR "bid_ledger_entries"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL

orders_auction_source.name: orders_auction_source
orders_auction_source.value: "orders"."source" NOT IN ('AUCTION_WIN', 'AUCTION_BUY_NOW') OR "orders"."auction_id" IS NOT NULL

payments_target.name: payments_target
payments_target.value: ("payments"."kind" = 'ORDER' AND "payments"."order_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("payments"."kind" = 'BID_PACK' AND "payments"."bid_package_order_id" IS NOT NULL)

promotion_redemptions_target.name: promotion_redemptions_target
promotion_redemptions_target.value: "promotion_redemptions"."order_id" IS NOT NULL OR "promotion_redemptions"."bid_package_order_id" IS NOT NULL

reward_ledger_sign_by_type.name: reward_ledger_sign_by_type
reward_ledger_sign_by_type.value: ("reward_ledger_entries"."type"::text LIKE 'EARN_%' AND "reward_ledger_entries"."points" > 0) OR ("reward_ledger_entries"."type" IN ('REDEEM', 'EXPIRE') AND "reward_ledger_entries"."points" < 0) OR "reward_ledger_entries"."type" = 'ADJUST'
